smell: The package has extensive fixture coverage for RDF terms, JSON-LD, vocabulary constants, and semantic metadata, but only SemanticSchemaMetadata has an S.toArbitrary-derived round-trip proof. Core RDF terms, datasets, JSON-LD models, evidence models, and PROV models are not property-tested from their production schemas.
proposedTarget: Add additive property tests using S.toArbitrary (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:12970) for NamedNode, BlankNode, Literal, Quad, Dataset, JsonLdDocument, JsonLdFrame, EvidenceSelector/EvidenceAnchor, and ProvO where generated values are stable. IRI schemas already define custom toArbitrary annotations at packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/src/Iri.ts:887. Mirror packages/foundation/modeling/md/test/Md.test.ts:45 and :150 or packages/tooling/test-kit/test-utils/src/Schema.ts:36.

smell: MakeLiteralOptions.language is S.optional(S.String) while Literal.language decodes through the LanguageTag schema. Invalid language tags can enter the helper options surface and fail only later when constructing Literal.
proposedTarget: Use LanguageTag in MakeLiteralOptions, or decode the overload's string language into LanguageTag before constructing Literal. The existing LanguageTag schema is packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/src/Rdf.ts:329 and Literal.language already uses it at :465.

smell: JSON-LD term definition @id and @type are modeled as broad strings even though the package already has IRIReference and JsonLdNodeIdentifier schemas and examples use IRI values.
proposedTarget: Use IRIReference or JsonLdNodeIdentifier for @id, depending on whether blank node identifiers and relative references should be accepted, and use S.OptionFromOptionalKey(IRIReference) for @type. IRIReference is verified locally at packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/src/Iri.ts:887 and includes a toArbitrary annotation.

smell: JsonLdContext.terms uses S.Record(S.String, S.Union([S.String, JsonLdTermDefinition])). Empty keys and arbitrary string values decode even though term bindings should be compact terms or IRI references.
proposedTarget: Introduce a JsonLdTermName schema, at minimum S.NonEmptyString with keyword exclusions if needed, and use S.Record(JsonLdTermName, S.Union([IRIReference, JsonLdTermDefinition])). S.NonEmptyString is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8420.

smell: JsonLdLiteralValue.@language is S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.String), duplicating the broader form already tightened by RDF Literal.language.
proposedTarget: Use LanguageTag for @language. If importing LanguageTag from Rdf.ts would introduce a cycle, move the language-tag schema to a small shared module and re-export it from Rdf.ts. The target schema is packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/src/Rdf.ts:329.

smell: JsonLdNodeObject.properties uses S.Record(S.String, S.Array(JsonLdPropertyValue)), allowing empty property names and empty value arrays.
proposedTarget: Use JsonLdTermName or IRIReference for property keys, and consider S.NonEmptyArray(JsonLdPropertyValue) for property values if empty property arrays are not meaningful. S.NonEmptyArray is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:4533.

smell: JsonLdFrame.includeProperties is an optional array of broad strings. The test fixture uses an IRI value, and empty property names or empty include lists decode.
proposedTarget: Use IRIReference or JsonLdTermName for includeProperties elements, and use S.NonEmptyArray when present. The fixture at packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/test/Rdf.test.ts:535 uses https://schema.org/name.

smell: Text-position selectors use NonNegativeInt for start and end but do not enforce end >= start. The Web Annotation adapter mirrors the same unordered pair at WebAnnotation.ts:93.
proposedTarget: Add a start <= end check to TextPositionSelector and WebAnnotationTextPositionSelector, and add a custom toArbitrary annotation if schema-derived arbitrary tests are added. The NLP handoff Span model is the local exemplar for this exact invariant at packages/foundation/modeling/nlp/src/Handoff/Contract.ts:151 through :198.

smell: Dataset equivalence is implemented by sorting quads and comparing serialized forms rather than using S.toEquivalence(Dataset).

exception.reason: RDF dataset equivalence is intentionally order-insensitive and based on sorted quad serialization. S.toEquivalence(Dataset) would compare array order and miss the package's semantic equivalence basis.

smell: URI equality is a hand comparison after normalization rather than schema-derived equivalence.

exception.reason: The helper intentionally normalizes URI references before comparison, including case/default-port/percent-encoding behavior. Schema-derived equality over strings would be too strict.

smell: Vocabulary drift coverage is table/golden based rather than S.toArbitrary based.

exception.reason: The test compares namespace and term constants against the identity CoreVocab registry. This is a deliberate drift guard over a finite checked-in vocabulary, not a schema law.

smell: Vocabulary namespace assertions are golden constant checks rather than property-based tests.

exception.reason: These assertions pin well-known RDF/OA/OWL/PROV/SKOS/XSD namespace and term constants. Property generation would not verify the registry constants these tests are protecting.

smell: RDF Literal.value is a broad S.String and can look like an unbounded primitive smell.

exception.reason: RDF literal lexical forms are arbitrary strings; datatype and language are modeled separately. Tightening Literal.value would be datatype-specific and outside the generic RDF literal boundary.

smell: PROV Entity.value permits a broad scalar union of string, finite number, or boolean.

exception.reason: prov:value is a generic provenance attribute whose datatype is supplied by the represented artifact or downstream RDF serialization. A closed scalar domain here would be profile-specific.
